headline.caveat: ~$20B of NVIDIA GPUs to be purchased by the SPV and leased to xAI over ~5 years; lease payment schedule undisclosed. Final close of the full raise not publicly confirmed

realized_to_date.caveat: GPU deliveries to Colossus 2 ramping from late 2025; amounts deployed not disclosed

nature_md: The delivery leg of the xAI GPU SPV structure: the SPV (equity ~$7.5B anchored by Valor, incl. up to $2B from NVIDIA; debt ~$12.5B via Apollo/Diameter et al.) buys ~$20B of NVIDIA GPUs and leases them to xAI for ~5 years to equip the Colossus 2 campus in Memphis. Direction here follows the capital: the SPV funds and delivers the GPUs xAI uses; xAI's lease/rental payments flow back to the SPV over the term and service the debt. Structured partly as lease-to-own per some reports. xAI gets compute without $20B of debt on its own balance sheet; the SPV's lenders bear GPU-residual-value and xAI-credit risk.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: The SPV capitalizes the GPUs as leased assets, carries the ~$12.5B of collateralized debt, and earns lease income from xAI. If GPUs outlive the lease at good residual values, equity wins; if not, losses cascade up from equity into the GPU-backed debt.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: xAI records a lease (right-of-use asset and lease liability under ASC 842 if finance/operating lease, magnitude far below $20B of debt) — the accounting keeps Colossus 2's compute cost off xAI's debt stack. Lease payments become xAI opex over 5 years, backloading the cash burden onto a company still burning cash.

both_sides_md: **Bear:** a 5-year lease against GPUs whose economic life the shorts put at ~3 years, paid by a pre-profit lab, financed at SPV level so no one balance sheet shows the whole obligation — Burry/Kedrosky's depreciation and 'price-it-like-a-utility' critiques apply squarely. **Bull:** CoreWeave's evidence that A100s re-lease at ~95% of original rates into 2029 supports GPU residual values; the SPV isolates risk with real third-party capital rather than hiding it (CoreWeave earnings; SemiAnalysis fundability view).
